title: The Shed Antler
text: An antler as long as a man lies in the bracken, freshly shed, its root still bloody. The quarry is near, lighter now and angry with the ache of it. Its tracks lead off through the trees, deep and fresh.

options.label: Take the antler; bone like that is worth carrying.

outcomes.text: It is wyrmbone, or near enough, still warm at the root.

options.label: The craftiest uses it as bait to draw the angry quarry back.

outcomes.text: The quarry comes back for it and finds you waiting.

options.label: The sharpest follows the fresh trail while the quarry still aches.

outcomes.text: You are close now. You can hear it.
